headline: World Bank Plans $4 Billion in New Financing for Türkiye
summary: The World Bank is working to provide about $4 billion in new financing for Türkiye in the fiscal year ending June 2027.
why: Multilateral development bank financing supports macroeconomic stability and infrastructure investment in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: New financing packages from the World Bank provide capital inflows to support the country's fiscal and development needs.
